notes.title: Get ADventureLib + 4 Games and 2 Albums for $3!
notes.notes:
Groupees has launched the Miller on the Roof bundle, including ADventure Lib and it's soundtrack. It's all one tier, so $3 gets you five games (all redeemable on steam) and two albums. Noah T's album is royalty free - so it's great if you want to add music to a game or stream, and lets not forget the famous HP Lovecraft Historical Society's album "A Shoggoth on the Roof!"

You can check out the bundle here: [url=https://groupees.com/millerontheroof]Miller on the Roof[/url]

[h1]The Games:[/h1]
[list]
[*]ASTROKILL
[*]Rolling Sun
[*]Kumoon : Ballistic Physics Puzzle
[*]ADventure Lib (includes DRM-free version and soundtrack)
[/list]

[h1]The Albums:[/h1]
[*]Noah T's Royalty Free Pack
[*]HP Lovecraft Historical Society's A Shoggoth on the Roof
[/list]

notes.title: You wanted more? And Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
ADventure Lib has been released to the wild, wild web! It's making some people laugh, and others face-palm, but the consensus seems to be that people want more! Well, I'm not surprised... 20 minutes of AdLibs is better than 10 minutes of AdLibs...

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/39/38617/thumb_620x2000/ADventureLib_2015-08-06_09-09-37-21.png[/img]

So, the good news is that we have written an outline for a second, longer, campaign to the game, which we plan to release as a free update around the end of this year. We'll also be adding a campaign editor that will allow players to create and share their own campaigns to the game (and share them via Steam Workshop). I will be posting more announcements about this as it gets closer to completion!

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/39/38617/thumb_620x2000/kitten-tradingcards.png[/img]

Last, but certainly not least, we have added trading cards to the game! Play the game to collect them, swap them around with your friends to get all sorts of wacky combinations!

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/39/38617/thumb_620x2000/ADventureLib_2015-08-06_09-07-17-11.png[/img]
Charles, Elizabeth and a King! What are the chances?
